tspan.tspan: Not used on login: holds only
session revoked? user disabled? tenant deleted?
checkSession: ended? user active? role same?
From here every route rejects this token with
session revoked? user disabled? tenant deleted?
sender from caller header (no token check),
validate batch; body identity must match it
Only the gateway verifies tokens. Ingestion and insights
trust its x-basketline-caller header: only the gateway
(all GET, served by insights-service; the tenant always comes from the token):
/api/v1/ad/:campaignId/:metric?from&to&storeId: clicks, impressions, clickToBasket, uniqueCustomers or sessions → daily_campaign_aggregation + daily_campaign_customers_aggregation (sessions:
/api/v1/ad/:campaignId/products?from&to&storeId: results per product with CTR and click-to-basket → daily_campaign_product_aggregation joined with campaign_products
/api/v1/ad/campaigns: the tenant's campaigns with activity, per store → daily_campaign_aggregation (user access token only)
Callers: any user's access token (any role), or for 1 and 2 also a store backend's integration token.
else verify the user's access token (any role)
tenantId from the caller header (no token check);
campaignId UUID, metric name, period ≤ 366 days
metric API only: cache lookup (15 s)
products API only: CTR = clicks / impressions,
